The Bank of Korea
Monetary Policy Decision

The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided
today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight
rate) at its current level (4.50%) for the intermeeting period.

(The following is an English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee
statement.)

In the real economy, while exports continue to show steady
growth, facilities and construction investment maintains a robust
growing pace and private consumption appears to be recovering.

Meanwhile, the current account has recorded a surplus, thanks to
the widened goods account surplus.
Consumer price inflation and core inflation both remain stable.
The upward pace of real estate prices has slowed down.

In the financial markets, overall liquidity conditions are favorable
and financial institutions' lending has shown a steady increase led by
those to small and medium enterprises.

Taking the above economic and financial conditions into
consideration, the Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea
decided today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight
rate) at its current level (4.50%) for the intermeeting period.
